briefs.target_angle: Focus on the 'High-Value Fix for Low Cost' narrative using a common daily driver vehicle
briefs.why_it_works: The data shows that 'Fixing Major Engine BlowBy on a Ford Ranger for $38' (4.5x ratio) significantly outperforms channels with similar subscriber counts when the cost-to-repair is explicitly low. Small channels win by proving that high-ticket engine issues don't always require professional shop rates, which builds immediate trust and authority.
pattern_insights: Explicitly mentioning a low, specific dollar amount for a major repair in the title
Focusing on 'Fixing' rather than 'Maintaining' to target acute viewer pain points
High-contrast 'Before/After' visual storytelling of a complex mechanical failure
Addressing specific vehicle models to capture high-intent search traffic

titles.title_1_search_match: Fixing Major Engine Misfire for Under $50
titles.title_2_curiosity: Is This $40 Fix Better Than A Shop?
titles.title_3_value: Stop Paying For Engine Repairs: $40 DIY Fix
titles.reason: It clearly communicates the problem (engine misfire) and the solution (a sub-$50 fix), which directly mirrors the successful packaging of the Ford Ranger video.

briefs.hook_script: Most shops told me this engine was toast and quoted me two thousand dollars for the repair. But after spending just forty dollars and about an hour in my driveway, I got it running perfectly again. Here is exactly how I diagnosed the issue and how you can do the same thing without a professional garage.

thumbnail_direction.primary_image: Split screen showing a dirty, disassembled engine part next to a clean, installed replacement part
thumbnail_direction.color_signal: High contrast red arrow pointing to the faulty component
thumbnail_direction.focal_point: The specific broken part being held in hand

pacing_outline.action: State the high shop quote vs your low cost, show the engine running rough.
Walk through the symptoms and the specific tools used to identify the failure.
Step-by-step assembly/disassembly, highlighting the specific $40 part.
Start the engine, demonstrate the fix, and provide a final cost breakdown.

production_checklist: Film in high-contrast lighting to show engine detail
Keep receipts visible to prove the $40 cost
Use a top-down camera angle for the repair process
Clearly label every bolt and part removed for viewer clarity
